mentions.name: sliced-areas
mentions.description: A Vue plugin that provides Blender-like UI areas, built on a pure planar graph, with UI interactions, an API, and customizable styles. It is about 90% done and is intended as a foundation for building gamedev and 3D-artist oriented tools.
mentions.problem: Vue lacks a Blender-style dockable/split UI area system, so the author is building one to later create SDF-based shader visualization tools.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on Blender-like UI areas Vue plugin. Pure planar graph, UI interactions, API, styles customization
